headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opens June 11 at Estadio Azteca
deck: Mexico City will host the opening ceremony featuring J Balvin, Maná, and other Latin stars 90 minutes before kickoff.
summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup begins on June 11, 2026, at Mexico City Stadium (Estadio Azteca) with an opening ceremony starting at 11:30 local time. For the first time in World Cup history, three host countries—Canada, Mexico, and the United States—will each hold opening ceremonies. The expanded tournament features 48 qualified teams competing in 104 matches across 16 host cities, with the final scheduled for July 19 at New York New Jersey Stadium.
